d: In this video, Firstpost explains how the internet has found its next billionaire honey-trap target, and this time, it's OpenAI CEO Sam Altman! After the Jensen Huang affair buzz took social media by storm, users are imagining what a potential honey trap for Altman would look like. Forget flowers, chocolates and romantic dinners. The internet's latest joke involves RAM! Altman's recent comments about hoarding large amounts of RAM in personal computers being inefficient have fuelled the memes. Meta's Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang has also found himself dragged into the online banter.…
